name: agentdrop

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev

description: Self-hosted artifact hosting for AI agents on Cloudflare Workers

TOKEN_PEPPER.description: Required secret used to hash device tokens and sign password cookies. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32` and **never change it** after launch.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Public URL of this instance, e.g. `https://drop.example.com`. Leave empty to use the URL each request arrives on.

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Browser origins allowed to call the API, comma-separated, or `*`.

MAX_FILE_MB.description: Largest file a device may upload, in MB.

MAX_STORAGE_MB.description: Active storage per owner (a linked account, or an unlinked device), in MB. `0` = unlimited.

MAX_TOTAL_STORAGE_MB.description: Active storage for the whole instance, in MB. `0` = unlimited.

RETENTION_DAYS.description: Days an upload from an unlinked device is kept.

RETENTION_DAYS_LINKED.description: Default days an upload from a linked device is kept.

MAX_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Longest expiry a linked device may choose, in days.

UPLOADS_PER_HOUR.description: Uploads per hour for a new device. `0` = new devices cannot upload until verified or linked.

UPLOADS_PER_DAY_VERIFIED.description: Uploads per day after the device passes Turnstile.

UPLOADS_PER_DAY_LINKED.description: Uploads per day for a device linked to an account.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Optional [Turnstile](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/turnstile) site key. Also set the `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` secret.

CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Optional: your Cloudflare Access team domain, e.g. `https://acme.cloudflareaccess.com`. Enables the dashboard and device linking.

CF_ACCESS_AUD.description: Optional: Audience (AUD) tag of the Access application that protects `/dashboard` and `/link`.
